title: 的 / 地 / 得 Step 4 · The Big Sort and Fix-It
description: Long sorting rounds, then real mistakes to catch — the kind even native speakers make in texts.

points.title: Sorting at speed
points.summary: Two looks per blank: right (noun/verb?) and left (verb before?).
points.body:
Practise until it's automatic.

| | comes before … | pattern | example |
|---|---|---|---|
| **的** | a **noun** | describer + 的 + noun | 漂亮**的**衣服 · 我买**的**书 |
| **地** | a **verb** (how it's done) | describer + 地 + verb | 慢慢**地**走 · 认真**地**学习 |
| **得** | the **result** (after the verb) | verb / adj. + 得 + how | 跑**得**很快 · 累**得**不想动 |

**The trick:** look **right** — a noun next → 的, a verb next → 地. Look **left** — a verb or adjective just before → 得. (All three are read *de*.)

points.title: Common mistakes
points.summary: 得 right after an object, 的 before a verb, 地 before a noun.
points.body:
- ~~他说中文得很好~~ → 他说中文**说得**很好
- ~~慢慢的走~~ → 慢慢**地**走
- ~~漂亮地衣服~~ → 漂亮**的**衣服

|---|---|---|---|
| **的** | a **noun** | describer + 的 + noun | 漂亮**的**衣服 · 我买**的**书 |

| **得** | the **result** (after the verb) | verb / adj. + 得 + how | 跑**得**很快 · 累**得**不想动 |

questions.prompt: Big sort, round 1: 的, 地 or 得?
questions.explanation: Noun next → 的 · verb next → 地 · verb/adjective before → 得.
notes: 欢迎 is a verb → 地.
手机 is a noun → 的.
After 吃 → 得.
坐 is a verb → 地.
冬天 is a noun → 的.
After the adjective, a result → 得.
房间 is a noun → 的.

questions.prompt: Big sort, round 2: 的, 地 or 得?
questions.explanation: 激动 three times — three different de, decided by its neighbours.
notes: After 打 → 得.
季节 is a noun: the season I like most → 的.
哭 is a verb → 地.
So moved he couldn't speak: adjective + 得 + result.
听 is a verb → 地.
消息 is a noun → 的.

questions.prompt: Which sentences have a mistake? Select all of them.
questions.explanation: Check each de against its neighbours.
notes: 得 can't follow the object: 说中文**说得**很好.
✔ verb + 得 + comparison.
✔ 的 + noun.
衣服 is a noun → 漂亮**的**衣服.
After the verb → 唱**得**很好听.
✔ 地 + verb.

questions.prompt: Which sentences are **correct**? Select all of them.
questions.explanation: 的 + noun · 地 + verb · verb + 得.
notes: Copy the verb: 唱歌**唱得**好.
✔ object first, then verb + 得.
✔ 地 + verb.
人 is a noun → 安静**的**人.
Scrambled: 他跑得不快 or 他跑得很快.
✔ verb + 得.

questions.prompt: Fix it: 「{他|tā}{说|shuō}{中文|Zhōngwén}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。」 Which correction is right?
questions.explanation: Copy the verb: 说中文**说得**很好.
notes: Nothing can stand between 得 and the comment.
的 needs a noun after it.
地 needs a verb after it.

questions.prompt: Build it: 'The teacher patiently explained a very hard question.'
questions.explanation: 老师**耐心地**讲了一个**很难的问题**。 地 + verb, 的 + noun.
questions.translation: The teacher patiently explained a very hard question.
